name: p2_1_letter_dimensions
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that displays the dimensions of a letter-size (8.5 × 11 inches) sheet of paper in millimeters. There are 25.4 millimeters per inch. Use constants and comments in your program.

name: p2_2_letter_perimeter
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that computes and displays the perimeter of a letter-size (8.5 × 11 inches) sheet of paper and the length of its diagonal.

name: p2_3_power_functions
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a number and displays the square, cube, and fourth power. Use the Math.pow method only for the fourth power.

dafny.method_signature: powerFunctions (x: int) returns (sq: int, cube : int, fourth: int)

name: p2_4_sum
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the sum.

name: p2_4_difference
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the difference.

name: p2_4_product
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the product.

name: p2_4_average
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the average.

name: p2_4_distance
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the distance (absolute value of the difference).

ensures: if x >= y then result == x - y else result == y - x

name: p2_4_max
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the maximum of the two.

ensures: if x >= y then result == x  else result == y

name: p2_4_min
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints the minimum of the two.

ensures: nsures if x <= y then result == x  else result == y

name: p2_6_convert
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for a measurement in meters and then converts it to miles, feet, and inches.

dafny.method_signature: convert (x: real) returns (miles: real, feet: real, inches: real)

name: circle_properties
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for a radius and then prints the area and circumference of a circle with that radius and the volume and surface area of a sphere with that radius.

dafny.method_signature: circle_properties(radius: real) returns (circumference: real, area: real, surface_area: real, volume: real)

name: rectangle_properties
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that asks the user for the lengths of the sides of a rectangle. Then print the area and perimeter of the rectangle and the length of the diagonal (use the Pythagorean theorem).

dafny.method_signature: rectangle_properties(length: real, width: real) returns (area: real, perimeter: real, diagonal: real)
ensures: diagonal * diagonal == length * length + width * width

name: hybrid_car_cost
nat_lang_statement: Write a program that helps a person decide whether to buy a hybrid car. The program's inputs should be the cost of a new car, the estimated miles driven per year, the estimated gas price, the efficiency in miles per gallon, and the estimated resale value after 5 years. Compute the total cost of owning the car for five years. For simplicity, do not take the cost of financing into account.

dafny.method_signature: hybrid_car_cost(new_car_cost: real, miles_per_year: real, gas_price: real, mpg: real, resale_value: real) returns (total_cost: real)
